mapper.select:
select c1.c_name as conPartyBName, pro.p_name as pName, con.con_name as conName, con.con_type as conType, con.con_Money_Total as conMoneyTotal, con.con_Money_Tentative as conMoneyTentative, con.con_Party_A_Agent as conPartyAAgent, (select fa.fa_Approved_Amt from Inv_Final_Accounts_Apply fa where fa.con_id=mn.con_id and fa.fa_state=7 limit 1) as faApprovedAmt, (select sa.as_Audited_Amount from Audit_Settlement sa where sa.con_id=mn.con_id and sa.as_state=7 limit 1) as asAuditedAmount, (select sum(Fad_Actual_Payment) from Fund_Allocation_Dtl fad left join Fund_Allocation fua on fua.id=fad.fa_id where fad.con_id=mn.con_id and fua.State=7) as fadActualPaymentSum, sd.d_name as conDepartment from Con_Contract con left join Pre_Project pro on pro.P_Id = mn.P_Id left join sys_company c1 on c1.c_name=con.Con_Party_B_Id left join sys_department sd on sd.d_id=con.con_department where con.Con_Payment_State=2 and con.Con_Approval_State=7 and (select count(*) from con_pay cp where cp.con_id=con.con_id and (cp.Contract_Pay_Type = '1' or cp.Contract_Pay_Type is null) and cp.Pay_State=7) > 0
and con.con_Party_A_Id=#{params.conPartyAId}

select sum(payApplyCount) as "payApplyCount", sum(payDoneTotalCount) as "payDoneTotalCount", sum(payChangeCount) as "payChangeCount", sum(payThisChangeAmountCount) as "payThisChangeAmountCount", sum(payFarmersPeriod) as "payFarmersPeriod", coalesce(sum(payFarmersPeriod), 0) as "payFarmersExpenditureTotal", sum(payApprovalCount) as "payApprovalCount",
(select count(*) from Con_Pay cp where cp.Con_Id = #{conId} and cp.Pay_Type=#{payType} and cp.Pay_State = 7)+1 as "batchNo",
(select sum(cp.Pay_Bonus) from Con_Pay cp where cp.Con_Id = #{conId} and (cp.Contract_Pay_Type = '1' or cp.Contract_Pay_Type is null) and cp.Pay_State = 7 ) as "payBonusLast", (select sum(cp.Pay_Deduct_ZBJ) from Con_Pay cp where cp.Con_Id = #{conId} and (cp.Contract_Pay_Type = '1' or cp.Contract_Pay_Type is null) and cp.Pay_State = 7 ) as "payDeductZbjLast", (select sum(cp.Pay_Deduct_Fine) from Con_Pay cp where cp.Con_Id = #{conId} and (cp.Contract_Pay_Type = '1' or cp.Contract_Pay_Type is null) and cp.Pay_State = 7 ) as "payDeductFineLast", (select sum(cp.Pay_Deduct_YFK) from Con_Pay cp where cp.Con_Id = #{conId} and (cp.Contract_Pay_Type = '1' or cp.Contract_Pay_Type is null) and cp.Pay_State = 7 ) as "payDeductYfkLast", (select sum(cp.Pay_Deduct_Sc) from Con_Pay cp where cp.Con_Id = #{conId} and (cp.Contract_Pay_Type = '1' or cp.Contract_Pay_Type is null) and cp.Pay_State = 7 ) as "payDeductScLast", (select sum(cp.pay_apply_sup) from Con_Pay cp where cp.Con_Id = #{conId} and (cp.Contract_Pay_Type = '1' or cp.Contract_Pay_Type is null) and cp.Pay_State = 7 ) as "payApplySupLast", (select sum(cp.Pay_Deduct_QT) from Con_Pay cp where cp.Con_Id = #{conId} and (cp.Contract_Pay_Type = '1' or cp.Contract_Pay_Type is null) and cp.Pay_State = 7 ) as "payDeductQtLast", (select sum(cp.Pay_Payable) from Con_Pay cp where cp.Con_Id = #{conId} and (cp.Contract_Pay_Type = '1' or cp.Contract_Pay_Type is null) and cp.Pay_State = 7 ) as "payPayableLast", (select sum(cp.Pay_Liquidated_Damages) from Con_Pay cp where cp.Con_Id = #{conId} and (cp.Contract_Pay_Type = '1' or cp.Contract_Pay_Type is null) and cp.Pay_State = 7 ) as "payLiquidatedDamagesCount", (select max(cp.Pay_Security_Costs) from Con_Pay cp where cp.Con_Id = #{conId} and (cp.Contract_Pay_Type = '1' or cp.Contract_Pay_Type is null) and cp.Pay_State = 7 ) as "paySecurityCosts", (select sum(case when sam.Ecf_Apply_Money_Type=1 then sam.Ecf_Apply_Money else -1*sam.Ecf_Apply_Money end) from Con_EC_Fee sam where sam.Con_Id=#{conId} and sam.Ecf_State=7) as "payThisChangeAmount", (select sum(pat.At_Money) from Pc_Award_Ticket pat where pat.Con_Id=#{conId} and pat.At_State=7 and pat.At_Type='0') as "payBonus", (select sum(pat.At_Money) from Pc_Award_Ticket pat where pat.Con_Id=#{conId} and pat.At_State=7 and pat.At_Type='1') as "payDeductFine" from (select sum(Pay_Change) as payChangeCount, sum(Pay_Approval) as payApprovalCount, sum(Pay_This_Change_Amount) as payThisChangeAmountCount, sum(Pay_Apply) as payApplyCount, sum(Pay_Farmers_Expenditure) as payFarmersPeriod, sum(Pay_Done) as payDoneTotalCount from Con_Pay where Con_Id = #{conId} and (Contract_Pay_Type = '1' or Contract_Pay_Type is null) and Te_Id = #{teId} and Pay_State = 7 and Pay_Type_Detailed!='0201' and pay_type = #{payType} union select sum(Pay_Change) as payChangeCount, sum(Pay_Approval) as payApprovalCount, sum(Pay_This_Change_Amount) as payThisChangeAmountCount, sum(Pay_Apply_Owner) as payApplyCount, sum(Pay_Farmers_Expenditure) as payFarmersPeriod, sum(case when Pay_Done_Owner is null then Pay_Done_Total else Pay_Done_Owner end ) as payDoneTotalCount from Con_Pay where Con_Id=#{conId} and (Contract_Pay_Type = '1' or Contract_Pay_Type is null) and Te_Id = #{teId} and Pay_State=7 and Pay_Type_Detailed='0201' and pay_type = #{payType} ) a

select sum(payApplyCount) as "payApplyCount", sum(payDoneTotalCount) as "payDoneTotalCount", sum(payChangeCount) as "payChangeCount", sum(payThisChangeAmountCount) as "payThisChangeAmountCount", sum(payFarmersPeriod) as "payFarmersPeriod", sum(payApprovalCount) as "payApprovalCount",
(select count(*) from Con_Pay cp where cp.Con_Id = #{conId} and (cp.Contract_Pay_Type = '1' or cp.Contract_Pay_Type is null) and cp.Pay_Type=#{payType} and cp.Pay_State = 7 and cp.Pay_Type_Detailed=#{payTypeDetailed}cp. )+1 as "batchNo",
(select sum(cp.Pay_Bonus) from Con_Pay cp where cp.Con_Id = #{conId} and (cp.Contract_Pay_Type = '1' or cp.Contract_Pay_Type is null) and cp.Pay_State = 7 ) as "payBonusLast", (select sum(cp.Pay_Deduct_ZBJ) from Con_Pay cp where cp.Con_Id = #{conId} and (cp.Contract_Pay_Type = '1' or cp.Contract_Pay_Type is null) and cp.Pay_State = 7 ) as "payDeductZbjLast", (select sum(cp.Pay_Deduct_Fine) from Con_Pay cp where cp.Con_Id = #{conId} and (cp.Contract_Pay_Type = '1' or cp.Contract_Pay_Type is null) and cp.Pay_State = 7 ) as "payDeductFineLast", (select sum(cp.Pay_Deduct_YFK) from Con_Pay cp where cp.Con_Id = #{conId} and (cp.Contract_Pay_Type = '1' or cp.Contract_Pay_Type is null) and cp.Pay_State = 7 ) as "payDeductYfkLast", (select sum(cp.Pay_Deduct_Sc) from Con_Pay cp where cp.Con_Id = #{conId} and (cp.Contract_Pay_Type = '1' or cp.Contract_Pay_Type is null) and cp.Pay_State = 7 ) as "payDeductScLast", (select sum( case when cp.Pay_Apply_Owner is not null then cp.Pay_Apply_Owner else cp.Pay_Apply end ) from Con_Pay cp where cp.Con_Id = #{conId} and cp.Pay_State = 7 and (cp.Contract_Pay_Type = '1' or cp.Contract_Pay_Type is null) and cp.pay_type = #{payType} and cp.Pay_Type_Detailed=#{payTypeDetailed} ) as "payApplySupLast", (select sum(cp.Pay_Deduct_QT) from Con_Pay cp where cp.Con_Id = #{conId} and (Contract_Pay_Type = '1' or Contract_Pay_Type is null) and cp.Pay_State = 7 ) as "payDeductQtLast", (select sum(cp.Pay_Payable) from Con_Pay cp where cp.Con_Id = #{conId} and (Contract_Pay_Type = '1' or Contract_Pay_Type is null) and cp.Pay_State = 7 ) as "payPayableLast", (select sum(cp.Pay_Liquidated_Damages) from Con_Pay cp where cp.Con_Id = #{conId} and (Contract_Pay_Type = '1' or Contract_Pay_Type is null) and cp.Pay_State = 7 and cp.pay_Payee=#{payPayee} and cp.pay_type = #{payType} and cp.Pay_Type_Detailed=#{payTypeDetailed} ) as "payLiquidatedDamagesCount", (select max(cp.Pay_Security_Costs) from Con_Pay cp where cp.Con_Id = #{conId} and (Contract_Pay_Type = '1' or Contract_Pay_Type is null) and cp.Pay_State = 7 ) as "paySecurityCosts", (select sum(case when sam.Ecf_Apply_Money_Type=1 then sam.Ecf_Apply_Money else -1*sam.Ecf_Apply_Money end) from Con_EC_Fee sam where sam.Con_Id=#{conId} and sam.Ecf_State=7) as "payThisChangeAmount", (select sum(pat.At_Money) from Pc_Award_Ticket pat where pat.Con_Id=#{conId} and pat.At_State=7 and pat.At_Type='0' and pat.at_C_Id=#{payPayee} ) as "payBonus", (select sum(pat.At_Money) from Pc_Award_Ticket pat where pat.Con_Id=#{conId} and pat.At_State=7 and pat.At_Type='1' and pat.at_C_Id=#{payPayee} ) as "payDeductFine" from (select sum(Pay_Change) as payChangeCount, sum(Pay_Approval) as payApprovalCount, sum(Pay_This_Change_Amount) as payThisChangeAmountCount, sum(Pay_Apply) as payApplyCount, sum(Pay_Farmers_Expenditure) as payFarmersPeriod, sum(Pay_Done) as payDoneTotalCount from Con_Pay where Con_Id = #{conId} and (Contract_Pay_Type = '1' or Contract_Pay_Type is null) and Pay_Apply_Owner is null and Te_Id = #{teId} and Pay_State = 7 and Pay_Type_Detailed=#{payTypeDetailed} and pay_type = #{payType} union select sum(Pay_Change) as payChangeCount, sum(Pay_Approval) as payApprovalCount, sum(Pay_This_Change_Amount) as payThisChangeAmountCount, sum(Pay_Apply_Owner) as payApplyCount, sum(Pay_Farmers_Expenditure) as payFarmersPeriod, sum(case when Pay_Done_Owner is null then Pay_Done_Total else Pay_Done_Owner end ) as payDoneTotalCount from Con_Pay where Con_Id=#{conId} and (Contract_Pay_Type = '1' or Contract_Pay_Type is null) and Pay_Apply_Owner is not null and Te_Id = #{teId} and Pay_State=7 and Pay_Type_Detailed=#{payTypeDetailed} and pay_type = #{payType} ) a

select SUM(mn.Pay_Approval) as accumulatedFees from Con_Pay mn where mn.Pay_Category = #{payCategory} and mn.Pay_State = 7 and mn.Con_Id is null and mn.Pay_Payee = #{cId} and (mn.Contract_Pay_Type = '1' or mn.Contract_Pay_Type is null)

select con.Con_Name as conName, con.Con_Code as conCode, con.Con_Money_Total as conMoneyTotal, con.Con_Money_Tentative as conMoneyTentative, con.Con_Section_Id as secId, con.Con_Ac_Pay_Rate as conAcPayRate, con.Con_Ac_Money as conAcMoney, con.Con_Progress_Ratio as conProgressRatio, con.Con_Type as conType, con.Con_Category as conCategory, con.Con_Pricing_Method as conPricingMethod, con.Con_Other_Valuation as conOtherValuation, con1.Con_Name as payRepairOneName, con2.Con_Name as payRepairTwoName, con3.Con_Name as payRepairThreeName, pro.P_Name as pName, pro.P_Code as pCode, pro.P_Name_History as pNameHistory, pro.P_Build_Model as pBuildModel, proc.C_Name as pConstructionUnitName, proc.C_Abbreviation as pConsAbbName, prod.D_Name as pCompetentDepartmentName, c1.C_Name_History as payPayeeNameHistory, c2.C_Name_History as payDraweeNameHistory, c3.C_Name_History as payApplicantNameHistory, c4.C_Name_History as conPartyBNameHistory, c1.C_Name as payPayeeName, c2.C_Name as payDraweeName, c3.C_Name as payApplicantName, c4.C_Name as conPartyBName, c5.C_Name as payPayeeName1, c1.C_Abbreviation as payPayeeAbbName, c2.C_Abbreviation as payDraweeAbbName, c3.C_Abbreviation as payApplicantAbbName, c4.C_Abbreviation as conPartyBAbbName, c4.c_Contactperson as cContactperson, c4.c_Contactpersontel as cContactpersontel, dep.D_Name as dName, dep1.D_Name as payApplicationDepartmentName, con.Con_Money_Total - mn.Pay_Total as conBalance, mea.Mea_Code as meaCode, f.file_relation_id as fileRelationId, ccp.Cpp_Clause as cppClause, mn.* from Con_Pay mn left join Con_Contract con on con.Con_Id = mn.Con_Id left join Pre_Project pro on pro.P_Id = mn.P_Id left join SYS_Company proc on proc.C_Id = pro.P_Construction_Unit left join SYS_Department prod on prod.D_Id = pro.P_Competent_Department left join SYS_Company c1 on c1.C_Id = mn.Pay_Payee left join SYS_Company c2 on c2.C_Id = mn.Pay_Drawee left join SYS_Department dep on dep.D_Id = mn.D_Id left join SYS_Company c3 on c3.C_Id = mn.Pay_Applicant_Id left join SYS_Company c4 on c4.C_Id = con.Con_Party_B_Id left join SYS_Company c5 on c5.C_Id = mn.Pay_Payee1 left join SYS_Department dep1 on dep1.D_Id = mn.Pay_Application_Department_Id left join Sys_File f on f.FileID = mn.Pay_Id left join Con_Contract con1 on con1.Con_Id = mn.Pay_Repair_One left join Con_Contract con2 on con2.Con_Id = mn.Pay_Repair_Two left join Con_Contract con3 on con3.Con_Id = mn.Pay_Repair_Three left join Con_Measure mea on mea.id = mn.Mea_Id left join Con_Contract_Pay_Plan ccp on ccp.Cpp_Id = mn.Cpp_Id where mn.Pay_Id = #{payId} and (mn.Contract_Pay_Type = '1' or mn.Contract_Pay_Type is null)

select sum(mn.Pay_Work_Amount_Total) as payWorkAmountTotalSum, sum(mn.Pay_Apply) as payApplySum, sum(mn.Pay_Unfinished_Work) as payUnfinishedWorkSum, sum(mn.Pay_Liquidated_Damages) as payLiquidatedDamagesSum, sum(mn.Pay_Deduct_Qt) as payDeductQtSum from Con_Pay mn left join Con_Contract con on con.Con_Id=mn.Con_Id
left join SYS_Company c1 on c1.C_Id=mn.Pay_Payee left join SYS_Company c2 on c2.C_Id=mn.Pay_Drawee left join SYS_Company c3 on c3.C_Id=mn.Pay_Applicant_Id left join SYS_Company c4 on c4.C_Id=con.Con_Party_B_Id left join SYS_Department dep on dep.D_Id=mn.D_Id left join SYS_Department dep1 on dep1.D_Id=mn.Pay_Application_Department_Id ${params.authSql}

select count(1) from Con_Pay mn left join Con_Contract con on con.Con_Id=mn.Con_Id left join SYS_Company c1 on c1.C_Id=mn.Pay_Payee left join SYS_Company c2 on c2.C_Id=mn.Pay_Drawee left join SYS_Company c4 on c4.C_Id=con.Con_Party_B_Id left join SYS_Department dep on dep.D_Id=mn.D_Id where mn.Con_Id=#{params.conId}

select pro.P_Name as pName, to_char((con.payCount / (select sum(Ipv_Planned_Investment) from Inv_Plan_Year where Ipv_State = 7 and Te_Id = #{teId} and Ipv_Declare_Year = to_char(now(), 'yyyy')))) as payRate from Pre_Project pro right join (select P_Id, sum(Pay_Apply) as payCount from Con_Pay where Pay_State = 7 and (Contract_Pay_Type = '1' or Contract_Pay_Type is null) and Te_Id = #{teId} and DateDiff(year,Pay_State_Time, getdate()) = 0 group by P_Id limit #{size}) con on con.P_Id = pro.P_Id where 1=1 and pro.Te_Id = #{teId} order by con.payCount desc

select to_char(Pay_State_Time, 'mm') as payMonth, sum(Pay_Apply) as payCount from Con_Pay where Pay_State = 7 and (Contract_Pay_Type = '1' or Contract_Pay_Type is null) and Te_Id = #{teId} and DateDiff(year,Pay_State_Time, getdate()) = 0 group by to_char(Pay_State_Time, 'mm') order by to_char(Pay_State_Time, 'mm') asc

select dep.D_Name as dName, res.payCount from SYS_Department dep right join (select con.Pay_Application_Department_Id as dId, sum(Pay_Apply) as payCount from Con_Pay con where con.Pay_State = 7 and (Contract_Pay_Type = '1' or Contract_Pay_Type is null) and con.Te_Id = #{teId} and DateDiff(year,con.Pay_State_Time, getdate()) = 0 group by con.Pay_Application_Department_Id) res on res.dId = dep.D_Id

select (select count(1) from Con_Pay where Pay_State = 7 and (Contract_Pay_Type = '1' or Contract_Pay_Type is null) and Te_Id = #{teId} and DateDiff(day,Pay_Create_Time, getdate()) = 0) as payToday, (COALESCE((select sum(Pay_Apply) from Con_Pay where Pay_State = 7 and (Contract_Pay_Type = '1' or Contract_Pay_Type is null) and Te_Id = #{teId} and Pay_Type!='02' and Pay_Type!='0201' and DateDiff(year, Pay_State_Time, getdate())=0), 0) +COALESCE((select sum(Pay_Apply_Owner) from Con_Pay where Pay_State=7 and (Contract_Pay_Type = '1' or Contract_Pay_Type is null) and Te_Id = #{teId} and (Pay_Type='02' or Pay_Type='0201' and DateDiff(year, Pay_State_Time, getdate())=0)), 0)) as payAmt, (COALESCE((select sum(Pay_Apply) from Con_Pay where Pay_State=7 and (Contract_Pay_Type = '1' or Contract_Pay_Type is null) and Te_Id = #{teId} and Pay_Type!='02' and Pay_Type!='0201' and DateDiff(month, Pay_State_Time, getdate())=0), 0) +COALESCE((select sum(Pay_Apply_Owner) from Con_Pay where Pay_State=7 and (Contract_Pay_Type = '1' or Contract_Pay_Type is null) and Te_Id = #{teId} and (Pay_Type='02' or Pay_Type='0201' and DateDiff(month, Pay_State_Time, getdate())=0)), 0)) as payMonthAmt, (select sum(Ipv_Planned_Investment) from Inv_Plan_Year where Ipv_State=7 and Te_Id = #{teId} and Ipv_Declare_Year=to_char(now(), 'yyyy')) as planAmt

select pro.P_Name as "pName", cast((con.payCount / (select sum(Ipv_Planned_Investment) from Inv_Plan_Year where Ipv_State = 7 and Te_Id = #{teId} and Ipv_Declare_Year = date_format(now(), '%Y'))) as DECIMAL) as "payRate" from Pre_Project pro right join (select P_Id, sum(Pay_Apply) as "payCount" from Con_Pay where Pay_State = 7 and (Contract_Pay_Type = '1' or Contract_Pay_Type is null) and Te_Id = #{teId} and date_format(Pay_State_Time, '%Y') - date_format(now(), '%Y') = 0 group by P_Id limit #{size}) con on con.P_Id = pro.P_Id where 1=1 and pro.Te_Id = #{teId} order by con.payCount desc

select date_format(Pay_State_Time, '%m') as "payMonth", sum(Pay_Apply) as "payCount" from Con_Pay where Pay_State = 7 and (Contract_Pay_Type = '1' or Contract_Pay_Type is null) and Te_Id = #{teId} and date_format(Pay_State_Time, '%Y') - date_format(now(), '%Y') = 0 group by date_format(Pay_State_Time, '%m') order by date_format(Pay_State_Time, '%m') asc

select dep.D_Name as dName, res.payCount from SYS_Department dep right join (select con.Pay_Application_Department_Id as dId, sum(Pay_Apply) as payCount from Con_Pay con where Pay_State = 7 and (Contract_Pay_Type = '1' or Contract_Pay_Type is null) and con.Te_Id = #{teId} and date_format(Pay_State_Time, '%Y') - date_format(now(), '%Y') = 0 group by con.Pay_Application_Department_Id) res on res.dId = dep.D_Id

select (select count(1) from Con_Pay where Pay_State = 7 and (Contract_Pay_Type = '1' or Contract_Pay_Type is null) and Te_Id = #{teId} and DateDiff(Pay_Create_Time, now()) = 0) as payToday, (IFNULL((select sum(Pay_Apply) from Con_Pay where Pay_State = 7 and (Contract_Pay_Type = '1' or Contract_Pay_Type is null) and Te_Id = #{teId} and Pay_Type!='02' and Pay_Type!='0201' and date_format(Pay_State_Time, '%Y')-date_format(now(), '%Y')=0), 0) +IFNULL((select sum(Pay_Apply_Owner) from Con_Pay where Pay_State=7 and (Contract_Pay_Type = '1' or Contract_Pay_Type is null) and Te_Id = #{teId} and (Pay_Type='02' or Pay_Type='0201' and date_format(Pay_State_Time, '%Y')-date_format(now(), '%Y')=0)), 0)) as payAmt, (IFNULL((select sum(Pay_Apply) from Con_Pay where Pay_State=7 and (Contract_Pay_Type = '1' or Contract_Pay_Type is null) and Te_Id = #{teId} and Pay_Type!='02' and Pay_Type!='0201' and PERIOD_DIFF(DATE_FORMAT(Pay_State_Time, '%Y%m'), DATE_FORMAT(now(), '%Y%m')) =0), 0) +IFNULL((select sum(Pay_Apply_Owner) from Con_Pay where Pay_State=7 and (Contract_Pay_Type = '1' or Contract_Pay_Type is null) and Te_Id = #{teId} and (Pay_Type='02' or Pay_Type='0201' and PERIOD_DIFF(DATE_FORMAT(Pay_State_Time, '%Y%m'), DATE_FORMAT(now(), '%Y%m'))=0)), 0)) as payMonthAmt, (select sum(Ipv_Planned_Investment) from Inv_Plan_Year where Ipv_State=7 and Te_Id = #{teId} and Ipv_Declare_Year=date_format(now(), '%Y')) as planAmt

select pro.P_Name as "pName", cast((con.payCount / (select sum(Ipv_Planned_Investment) from Inv_Plan_Year where Ipv_State = 7 and Te_Id = #{teId} and Ipv_Declare_Year = to_char(now(), 'yyyy'))) as DECIMAL) as "payRate" from Pre_Project pro right join (select P_Id, sum(Pay_Apply) as payCount from Con_Pay where Pay_State = 7 and (Contract_Pay_Type = '1' or Contract_Pay_Type is null) and Te_Id = #{teId} and date_part('year',cast(Pay_State_Time as TIMESTAMP)-cast(now() as TIMESTAMP))= 0 group by P_Id limit #{size}) con on con.P_Id = pro.P_Id where 1=1 and pro.Te_Id = #{teId} order by con.payCount desc

select to_char(Pay_State_Time, 'mm') as "payMonth", sum(Pay_Apply) as "payCount" from Con_Pay where Pay_State = 7 and (Contract_Pay_Type = '1' or Contract_Pay_Type is null) and Te_Id = #{teId} and date_part('year',cast(Pay_State_Time as TIMESTAMP)-cast(now() as TIMESTAMP)) = 0 group by to_char(Pay_State_Time, 'mm') order by to_char(Pay_State_Time, 'mm') asc

select dep.D_Name as "dName", res."payCount" from SYS_Department dep right join (select con.Pay_Application_Department_Id as "dId", sum(Pay_Apply) as "payCount" from Con_Pay con where con.Pay_State = 7 and (Contract_Pay_Type = '1' or Contract_Pay_Type is null) and con.Te_Id = #{teId} and date_part('year',cast(con.Pay_State_Time as TIMESTAMP)-cast(now() as TIMESTAMP)) = 0 group by con.Pay_Application_Department_Id) res on res."dId" = dep.D_Id

select (select count(1) from Con_Pay where Pay_State = 7 and (Contract_Pay_Type = '1' or Contract_Pay_Type is null) and Te_Id = #{teId} and date_part('day',cast(Pay_Create_Time as TIMESTAMP)-cast(now() as TIMESTAMP)) = 0) as "payToday", (COALESCE((select sum(Pay_Apply) from Con_Pay where Pay_State = 7 and (Contract_Pay_Type = '1' or Contract_Pay_Type is null) and Te_Id = #{teId} and Pay_Type!='02' and Pay_Type!='0201' and date_part('year',cast(Pay_State_Time as TIMESTAMP)-cast(now() as TIMESTAMP))=0), 0) +COALESCE((select sum(Pay_Apply_Owner) from Con_Pay where Pay_State=7 and (Contract_Pay_Type = '1' or Contract_Pay_Type is null) and Te_Id = #{teId} and (Pay_Type='02' or Pay_Type='0201' and date_part('year',cast(Pay_State_Time as TIMESTAMP)-cast(now() as TIMESTAMP))=0)), 0)) as "payAmt", (COALESCE((select sum(Pay_Apply) from Con_Pay where Pay_State=7 and (Contract_Pay_Type = '1' or Contract_Pay_Type is null) and Te_Id = #{teId} and Pay_Type!='02' and Pay_Type!='0201' and date_part('month',cast(Pay_State_Time as TIMESTAMP)-cast(now() as TIMESTAMP))=0), 0) +COALESCE((select sum(Pay_Apply_Owner) from Con_Pay where Pay_State=7 and (Contract_Pay_Type = '1' or Contract_Pay_Type is null) and Te_Id = #{teId} and (Pay_Type='02' or Pay_Type='0201' and date_part('month',cast(Pay_State_Time as TIMESTAMP)-cast(now() as TIMESTAMP))=0)), 0)) as "payMonthAmt", (select sum(Ipv_Planned_Investment) from Inv_Plan_Year where Ipv_State=7 and Te_Id = #{teId} and Ipv_Declare_Year=to_char(now(), 'yyyy')) as "planAmt"

select top 1 Pay_Total from Con_Pay where Con_Id = #{conId} and (Contract_Pay_Type = '1' or Contract_Pay_Type is null) and Pay_State = 7 and (Pay_Type is null or Pay_Type == '') order by pay_create_time desc

select sum(payDefaultTotal) from (select sum(Pay_Liquidated_Damages_Owner) as payDefaultTotal from Con_Pay where P_Id = #{pId} and (Contract_Pay_Type = '1' or Contract_Pay_Type is null) and Con_Id= #{conId} and Pay_State=7 and Pay_Type_Detailed='0201' union select sum(Pay_Liquidated_Damages) as payDefaultTotal from Con_Pay where P_Id = #{pId} and (Contract_Pay_Type = '1' or Contract_Pay_Type is null) and Con_Id= #{conId} and Pay_State=7 and Pay_Type_Detailed='0202' )

select mn.P_Id as projectId, mn.P_Name as pName, mn.P_Competent_Department as pCompetentDepartment, con.Con_Id as conId, con.Con_Name as conName, con.Con_Money_Total as conMoneyTotal, pay.Pay_Id as payId, pay.Pay_Approval as payApproval, pay.Pay_Payable as payPayable from Pre_Project mn left join Con_Contract con on mn.P_ID = con.Con_Project_Id and con.Con_Approval_State=7 left join Con_Pay pay on con.Con_Id = pay.Con_Id and pay.Pay_State=7 and pay.Pay_Category='01' and (pay.Contract_Pay_Type = '1' or pay.Contract_Pay_Type is null) ${authSql} and mn.state=7
and mn.P_Name like concat('%',#{pName},'%')

select con.Con_Name as conName, con.Con_Code as conCode, con.Con_Money_Total as conMoneyTotal, con.Con_Money_Tentative as conMoneyTentative, con.Con_Section_Id as secId, con.Con_Ac_Pay_Rate as conAcPayRate, con.Con_Ac_Money as conAcMoney, con.Con_Progress_Ratio as conProgressRatio, con.Con_Type as conType, con.Con_Pricing_Method as conPricingMethod, con.Con_Other_Valuation as conOtherValuation, con1.Con_Name as payRepairOneName, con2.Con_Name as payRepairTwoName, con3.Con_Name as payRepairThreeName, pro.P_Name as projectName, pro.P_Name as pName, pro.P_Code as pCode, pro.P_Name_History as pNameHistory, pro.P_Build_Model as pBuildModel, proc.C_Name as pConstructionUnitName, proc.C_Abbreviation as pConsAbbName, prod.D_Name as pCompetentDepartmentName, c1.C_Name_History as payPayeeNameHistory, c2.C_Name_History as payDraweeNameHistory, c3.C_Name_History as payApplicantNameHistory, c4.C_Name_History as conPartyBNameHistory, c1.C_Name as payPayeeName, c2.C_Name as payDraweeName, c3.C_Name as payApplicantName, c4.C_Name as conPartyBName, c5.C_Name as payPayeeName1, c1.C_Abbreviation as payPayeeAbbName, c2.C_Abbreviation as payDraweeAbbName, c3.C_Abbreviation as payApplicantAbbName, c4.C_Abbreviation as conPartyBAbbName, c4.c_Contactperson as cContactperson, c4.c_Contactpersontel as cContactpersontel, dep.D_Name as dName, dep1.D_Name as payApplicationDepartmentName, con.Con_Money_Total - mn.Pay_Total as conBalance, mea.Mea_Code as meaCode, f.file_relation_id as fileRelationId, ccp.Cpp_Clause as cppClause, mn.* from Con_Pay mn left join Con_Contract con on con.Con_Id = mn.Con_Id left join Pre_Project pro on pro.P_Id = mn.P_Id left join SYS_Company proc on proc.C_Id = pro.P_Construction_Unit left join SYS_Department prod on prod.D_Id = pro.P_Competent_Department left join SYS_Company c1 on c1.C_Id = mn.Pay_Payee left join SYS_Company c2 on c2.C_Id = mn.Pay_Drawee left join SYS_Department dep on dep.D_Id = mn.D_Id left join SYS_Company c3 on c3.C_Id = mn.Pay_Applicant_Id left join SYS_Company c4 on c4.C_Id = con.Con_Party_B_Id left join SYS_Company c5 on c5.C_Id = mn.Pay_Payee1 left join SYS_Department dep1 on dep1.D_Id = mn.Pay_Application_Department_Id left join Sys_File f on f.FileID = mn.Pay_Id left join Con_Contract con1 on con1.Con_Id = mn.Pay_Repair_One left join Con_Contract con2 on con2.Con_Id = mn.Pay_Repair_Two left join Con_Contract con3 on con3.Con_Id = mn.Pay_Repair_Three left join Con_Measure mea on mea.id = mn.Mea_Id left join Con_Contract_Pay_Plan ccp on ccp.Cpp_Id = mn.Cpp_Id where mn.Pay_Id = #{payId} and (mn.Contract_Pay_Type = '1' or mn.Contract_Pay_Type is null)

select tp.tp_dotime as tpDoTime,tp.ActName as actName,tp.tp_explain as tpExplain, concat((select Con_Value from SYS_Config where Con_Code='downloadUrl') , '/jpm/downloadOpenFile/',us.U_Signature) as imgUrl, us.U_Name as uName,us.U_Signature as uSignature from Sys_Task_Processin tp left join SYS_User us on tp.tp_user=us.U_ID left join SYS_FlowActivity act on act.ActID=tp.tp_actid where tp_entityid = #{params.fileId} and ActType not like '%Gateway' order by tp_dotime asc

select mn.P_Id as projectId, mn.P_Name as pName, mn.P_Competent_Department as pCompetentDepartment, dep.D_Name as pCompetentDepartmentName, mn.P_Build_Model as pBuildModel, case when mn.P_Project_Form_Type = '01' then mn.P_Approve_Budget when mn.P_Project_Form_Type = '02' then mn.P_Record_Amount when mn.P_Project_Form_Type = '03' then mn.P_Approval_Amount else mn.P_Calculate_Roughly_Amount end as pCalculateRoughlyAmount, pay.Pay_Id as payId, pay.Pay_Category as payCategory, pay.Pay_Approval as payApproval, pay.Pay_Payable as payPayable, mn.P_Project_Form_Type as pProjectFormType from Pre_Project mn left join sys_department dep on mn.P_Competent_Department=dep.D_ID left join Con_Pay pay on mn.P_Id = pay.P_Id and pay.Pay_State=7 and (pay.Contract_Pay_Type = '1' or pay.Contract_Pay_Type is null) ${params.authSql} and mn.state=7
and mn.P_Id = #{params.projectId}
and likePname(#{params.pName},mn.P_Id)=true
and mn.P_Name like concat('%',#{params.pName},'%')
and mn.P_Competent_Department like concat('%',#{params.pCompetentDepartment},'%')
and mn.P_Build_Model like concat('%',#{params.pBuildModel},'%')

select mn.*, c1.C_Name as payPayeeName from Con_Pay mn left join SYS_Company c1 on c1.C_Id = mn.Pay_Payee where mn.P_Id=#{projectId} and mn.Pay_State = 7 and (mn.Contract_Pay_Type = '1' or mn.Contract_Pay_Type is null) order by Pay_Create_Time desc

SELECT pre.p_id AS pId, SUM(pay.pay_apply) AS payapply, mn.con_id AS conId, pre.p_name AS pName, mn.con_name AS conName, mn.con_type AS conType, mn.Con_Party_B_Id AS conPartyBId, sys.c_name AS cName, mn.Con_Money_Total AS conMoneyTotal, ( mn.Con_Money_Total + COALESCE((SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN cc.Con_Sup_Change_Mon_Type = 1 THEN cc.Con_Sup_Change_Money WHEN cc.Con_Sup_Change_Mon_Type = 0 THEN -cc.Con_Sup_Change_Money ELSE 0 END ) FROM Con_Contract cc WHERE cc.Con_Sup = '是' AND cc.Con_Master_Con_Id IS NOT NULL AND cc.Con_Approval_State = 7 AND cc.Con_Master_Con_Id = mn.con_id), 0)) AS contractAmount, app.as_Audited_Amount AS settlementamount, mn.con_Party_A_Agent as conPartyAAgent, mn.con_Party_A_Agent_Id as conPartyAAgentId FROM con_contract mn LEFT JOIN con_Pay pay ON pay.con_id = mn.con_id and (pay.Contract_Pay_Type = '1' or pay.Contract_Pay_Type is null) LEFT JOIN pre_project pre ON pre.p_id = mn.Con_Project_Id LEFT JOIN SYS_Company sys ON sys.c_id = mn.Con_Party_B_Id LEFT JOIN Audit_Settlement app ON mn.con_id = app.con_id ${authSql}
and likePname(#{request.pName},pre.P_Id)=true
and pre.P_Name like concat('%',#{request.pName},'%')
and mn.conName like concat('%',#{request.conName},'%')
and mn.conCode = #{request.conCode}
and likeCname(#{request.cName},sys.C_Id)=true
and sys.c_name like concat('%',#{request.cName},'%')
GROUP BY pre.p_id, pre.p_name, mn.con_id, mn.con_name, mn.con_type, mn.Con_Party_B_Id, sys.c_name, mn.Con_Money_Total, app.as_Audited_Amount, mn.con_Party_A_Agent, mn.con_Party_A_Agent_Id

SELECT pre.p_id AS pId, SUM(pay.pay_apply) AS payapply, mn.con_id AS conId, pre.p_name AS pName, mn.con_name AS conName, mn.Con_Money_Total AS conMoneyTotal FROM con_contract mn LEFT JOIN con_Pay pay ON pay.con_id = mn.con_id and (pay.Contract_Pay_Type = '1' or pay.Contract_Pay_Type is null) LEFT JOIN pre_project pre ON pre.p_id = mn.Con_Project_Id LEFT JOIN SYS_Company sys ON sys.c_id = mn.Con_Party_B_Id LEFT JOIN Audit_Settlement app ON mn.con_id = app.con_id ${authSql}
and likePname(#{request.pName},pre.P_Id)=true
and pre.P_Name like concat('%',#{request.pName},'%')
and mn.conName like concat('%',#{request.conName},'%')
and mn.conCode = #{request.conCode}
and likeCname(#{request.cName},sys.C_Id)=true
and sys.c_name like concat('%',#{request.cName},'%')
GROUP BY pre.p_id, pre.p_name, mn.con_id, mn.con_name, mn.Con_Money_Total

select mn.Con_Id, ifnull(sum(mn.Pay_Apply), 0) as payApply from Con_Pay mn where mn.Pay_State = 7 and (mn.Contract_Pay_Type = '1' or mn.Contract_Pay_Type is null)
and mn.Con_Id in
#{conId}
group by mn.Con_Id
select mn.*, cp.Pay_Create_Time as payCreateTime from Con_Pay_Receipt mn left join Con_Pay cp on cp.Pay_Id = mn.Pay_Id where cp.P_Id = #{pId} and cp.Contract_Pay_Type = '4' and cp.Pay_State = 7

choose.when: and mn.Pay_State = 7 and (mn.Contract_Pay_Type = '1' or mn.Contract_Pay_Type is null) and DateDiff(day, mn.Pay_Create_Time, getdate()) = 0

and mn.Pay_State = 7 and (mn.Contract_Pay_Type = '1' or mn.Contract_Pay_Type is null) and DateDiff(year, mn.Pay_State_Time, getdate()) = 0 and ( (mn.Pay_Type != '02' and mn.Pay_Type != '0201') or (mn.Pay_Type = '02' or mn.Pay_Type = '0201') )

and mn.Pay_State = 7 and (mn.Contract_Pay_Type = '1' or mn.Contract_Pay_Type is null) and DateDiff(month, mn.Pay_State_Time, getdate()) = 0 and ( (mn.Pay_Type != '02' and mn.Pay_Type != '0201') or (mn.Pay_Type = '02' or mn.Pay_Type = '0201') )
and mn.Pay_State = 7 and (mn.Contract_Pay_Type = '1' or mn.Contract_Pay_Type is null) and DateDiff(mn.Pay_Create_Time, now()) = 0)

and mn.Pay_State = 7 and (mn.Contract_Pay_Type = '1' or mn.Contract_Pay_Type is null) and date_format(mn.Pay_State_Time, '%Y') - date_format(now(), '%Y') = 0 and ( (mn.Pay_Type != '02' and mn.Pay_Type != '0201') or (mn.Pay_Type = '02' or mn.Pay_Type = '0201') )

and mn.Pay_State = 7 and (mn.Contract_Pay_Type = '1' or mn.Contract_Pay_Type is null) and PERIOD_DIFF(DATE_FORMAT(mn.Pay_State_Time, '%Y%m'), DATE_FORMAT(now(), '%Y%m')) = 0 and ( (mn.Pay_Type != '02' and mn.Pay_Type != '0201') or (mn.Pay_Type = '02' or mn.Pay_Type = '0201') )

mapper.select: select pre.p_Name as pName, c.c_Name as pConstructionUnitName, con.Con_Code as conCode, con.Con_Name as conName, con.Con_Money_Total as conMoneyTotal, c2.C_Name as payPayeeName, mn.* from con_pay mn left join pre_project pre on pre.P_Id = mn.P_Id left join con_contract con on con.Con_Id = mn.Con_Id left join sys_company c on c.c_Id = pre.p_Construction_Unit left join sys_company c2 on c2.c_Id = mn.pay_Payee where mn.pay_Application_Type = '01' and mn.Pay_State = 7 and not exists ( select 1 from Market_Investment_Payment mip where mip.pay_Id = mn.Pay_Id )

select pro.P_Name as pName, con.Con_Name as conName, con.Con_Code as conCode, con.Con_Money_Total as conMoneyTotal, con.Con_Type as conType, c4.C_Name as conPartyBName, c4.C_Abbreviation as conPartyBAbbName, mn.*, mn.Pay_Approval as payApproval from Con_Pay mn left join Con_Contract con on con.Con_Id = mn.Con_Id left join Pre_Project pro on pro.P_Id = mn.P_Id left join SYS_Company c4 on c4.C_Id = con.Con_Party_B_Id ${params.authSql}
order by mn.Pay_Create_Time desc
